description: Work out which time works best for a Group Poll: for every candidate time, how many said yes, maybe and no, who they were, and which respondents haven't answered that time. Empty participant records with no yes/maybe/no votes are not respondents. Best times are ranked the way TroopRally's own rally page ranks them (yes 1, maybe 0.75, no -0.5). TroopRally doesn't keep a list of who was invited, so it can't say who never responded at all.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the readable times in the result, like America/Chicago. Defaults to the organizer's timezone.
